body:
### Summary

```
python3.11 -m uv init
uv add azure-cli adlfs
uv export --format requirements.txt --no-emit-project | grep pymsal
```

This outputs:

```
pymsalruntime==0.20.6
```

Instead of the expected:

```
pymsalruntime==0.20.6 ; sys_platform == 'darwin' or sys_platform == 'win32'
```

If I only add either one of `adlfs` and `azure-cli` then the marker is retained correctly.

`uv tree` and `uv sync` correctly identify that `pymsalruntime` should not be installed on Linux.

`uv pip compile` also (correctly?) does not output that as a dependency at all (not even with markers).

Attempting to install using the bad requirements.txt that lacks markers will fail because it tries to use a hash that isn't recorded.

### Platform

OpenSUSE Leap 15.6 [WSL2]

### Version

uv 0.12.23 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

### Python version

3.11.10
title: Export sometimes does not respect conditional platforms on extra packages
